mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past month signals an easing monetary policy that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, increasing S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 4.5%, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) over the past two months indicates robust consumer demand, driving corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS rise, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p>0.05 in regression).

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market (defined by unemployment rate below 4.0% and 3-month payroll growth exceeding 0.5%), a low unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals strong consumer spending and corporate hiring, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances meeting the trigger condition, or correlation between UNRATE and SPX returns is not positive (r < 0) in the trigger regime.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE) consistently signals strong labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE is below 4.0%, or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100, it signals a contraction in manufacturing and supply chain activity, reducing corporate earnings growth and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) over the past two months indicates strong consumer demand, driving corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS rise, or the interaction term in a regression is not significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 320), elevated inflation pressures prompt the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 320, or Rank IC is negative over any 1-year rolling window.
